# Ticket 04 — per-fixture Bronze comparison matrix

This file is the machine-generated evidence behind
[`ticket-04-discrepancies.md`](ticket-04-discrepancies.md). Both sides extract the
same committed authoritative XDR and canonicalize it identically; the digests
compared here are committed under `testdata/parity/`.

The **verdict** column is mechanical. It is not the ticket's review vocabulary —
deciding whether a difference is provenance-only, an approved semantic
difference or a bug is a reviewer's call, recorded in the discrepancy report.
Two verdicts are easy to misread:

- `both-empty` is **not** a pass. A table with no rows on either side has no
  columns to compare, so two entirely different schemas agree there.
- `equal` covers the compared columns only. Columns one side stamps with a
  wall clock are skipped, and this comparison is of extractor output, not of
  what each sink finally persists.
